note: Homepage 'Player of the week' module. An editor's pick, not a sales ranking: the jersey rank shown comes from the player's league's latest published report, and stats come from data/stats.json with their own through-date. To change the pick, set playerId, weekOf, headline, dek and why (each reason with a source URL), then run npm run validate.

hero.note: Homepage hero story. Editorial copy that points into a published ranking; change the headline, dek, link and photo player whenever a new list lands. The photo is that player's retailer jersey photo, and the rank shown under it comes from the latest published report.

headline: Messi's jersey leads MLS for a fourth straight year
dek: Major League Soccer's 2026 list, published Nov. 3, puts Lionel Messi's Inter Miami jersey at No. 1 on the MLS online store again, ahead of Son Heung-Min and Thomas Müller.

why.text: No. 1 on MLS's top-selling jersey list for 2026, covering MLS Store sales from January 1 to October 30.
It is the fourth year in a row that Messi has topped the league's jersey list.
Three Inter Miami players made the 2026 top 10: Messi, Luis Suárez (No. 8) and Rodrigo De Paul (No. 10).
